notas: The value is what the candidate themself declared to the Justiça Eleitoral when registering the candidacy. It is self-declaration, not an audit: no one verified these assets one by one.

Assets are recorded at acquisition value or at the value stated in the income tax return, not at today's market price. Therefore the difference between one year and another does not measure appreciation or enrichment.
The values are not adjusted for inflation. Comparing reais from 2018 with reais from 2026 understates the older amount.
A declaration only exists for an election year in which the person registered a candidacy — the list is inherently discontinuous by nature, and this says nothing about assets in the empty years.
Any eventual difference between what was declared to the Justiça Eleitoral and what was declared to the Receita Federal is not observable here.
Where it says 'não encontrado' ("not found"), the candidacy existed but the declared value was not located in a source that published it unambiguously. Nothing was estimated to fill the gap.
The 2026 values come from two independent surveys that match each other; earlier years come from news reports that explicitly cite the declaration to the TSE, with the link in each line.
